messages:
nora: Heads-up 10 - we need a "minimal artifacts" gate for the enterprise compliance epic. PM ask: make sign-off binary and automatable.

sam: Agreed. Minimal = things we can run on CI and hand to legal. No fuzzy statements.

peter: Proposed checklist (short):
```
- export_sample: ndjson export + sha256 hash + signed-manifest (service key)
- append_only_check: 7-day chained-checksum sample (scriptable)
- byok_cycle: handshake + export + restore using customer key sandbox (1 tenant)
- kms_rotate: auto rotate test + manual-escrow restore doc validated
- retention_tiers: hot=30d, warm=365d, cold=3650d; enforcement smoke in 2 regions
- soc2_snapshots: 3 evidence packs with access logs and retrieval timestamps
```

ops-bot: Note: retention tier change will need a metadata migration; expect a short backfill job. See playbook: <https://internal.redwood/playbooks/retention-migration>. Schedule during canary.

legal-ana: Contract language: send notice for any retention >90 days beyond customer baseline with 30-day window; escrow acceptance must include signed-manifest + verifier logs. I'll draft clause.

sam: Quick Qs: who signs the manifest? which tenants for BYOK test?

peter: Ops signs manifest with a rotation-protected service key; public key published in docs. BYOK tenants = dev, staging, one customer sandbox (non-prod).

nora: Action items: peter -> implement export & checksum scripts; ops -> rotation + signer svc; legal-ana -> clause PR; sam -> acceptance doc + CI smoke harness.

ops-bot: Reminder: cross-region replication must honor TTLs. File infra ticket to validate replication retention enforcement.

nora: Timeline: spikes this week, export/restore runs next, legal PR + final acceptance doc by sprint end. If all smoke tests pass on 3 tenants PM will mark gate ready. :white_check_mark:
